governance.description: Expert-driven only. No quantitative player-prop model impact. Every active recommendation has an explicit current-week direction and cited threshold; current sportsbook prices are not inferred.
governance.staleDataPolicy: Prior-week recommendations are archived and never carried forward.

sourceAudit.note: Completed-game rows are archived automatically and cannot remain actionable. Current recommendations contain only not-yet-started selected-week games.

closedRecommendations.game: Los Angeles Rams at Denver Broncos
closedRecommendations.thesis: Three independent expert source families converge on Corum's rushing volume. He cleared this range with 54 and 79 rushing yards in Weeks 1-2, Denver has allowed 5.1 yards per carry, and Puka Nacua's absence increases the likelihood of a run-heavier Rams plan.
closedRecommendations.risk: Kyren Williams can absorb passing-down and goal-line work; a negative game script would reduce Corum's early-down volume.

closedRecommendations.game: Los Angeles Rams at Denver Broncos
closedRecommendations.thesis: Sutton's longest catches through two games are 6 and 10 yards. The Rams have suppressed explosive passes, while Denver's quick-game structure and Jaylen Waddle's arrival reduce Sutton's downfield role.
closedRecommendations.risk: A single broken coverage or contested catch defeats a longest-reception under.

closedRecommendations.game: Los Angeles Rams at Denver Broncos
closedRecommendations.thesis: The supporting expert case expects Denver to lean on quick, high-percentage throws and notes Nix has reached 22 completions in 23 of 38 career games.
closedRecommendations.risk: Denver could play from ahead and reduce pass volume; the edge disappears if the market moves beyond 23.5.

closedRecommendations.game: Los Angeles Rams at Denver Broncos
closedRecommendations.thesis: With Puka Nacua inactive, Adams again projects as Matthew Stafford's primary red-zone and high-leverage target. He drew 10 targets and scored twice last week without Nacua.
closedRecommendations.risk: Touchdown props are inherently high variance and Kyren Williams or the tight ends can capture goal-line opportunities.

closedRecommendations.game: Los Angeles Rams at Denver Broncos
closedRecommendations.thesis: Waddle drew 10 targets and produced 138 receiving yards in Week 2, and Marvin Mims Jr.'s inactive status further concentrates Denver's wide-receiver opportunities.
closedRecommendations.risk: Denver can finish drives through its running backs, and Waddle's touchdown role is less established than his yardage volume.

closedWatchlist.game: Los Angeles Rams at Denver Broncos
closedWatchlist.thesis: One expert source projects Dobbins as Denver's lead early-down back and recommends 16+ carries.
closedWatchlist.risk: RJ Harvey is active and the backfield can remain a committee; no independent-source confirmation cleared the recommendation threshold.

closedWatchlist.game: Los Angeles Rams at Denver Broncos
closedWatchlist.thesis: Current expert directions conflict: DraftKings Network argues under 15.5 rushing yards while Action Network proposes 25+ rushing yards. The disagreement is preserved instead of forcing a pick.
closedWatchlist.risk: Quarterback rushing is sensitive to scramble opportunities and kneel-down scoring.
